canonical_project: Meta Hyperion AI supercluster / Richland Parish Meta data center
aliases: Meta Hyperion AI supercluster / Richland Parish Meta data center
Meta Richland Parish / Hyperion AI campus

location.site_context: Former Franklin Farm megasite between Rayville and Delhi; newer Meta/LED materials describe the site from Holly Ridge/Richland Parish, Louisiana.

status_as_of_cutoff: site work-construction with a major July 2026 announced expansion to a planned 5,000 MW / 5 GW compute-capacity buildout and more than $50 billion investment. Meta says construction began after the December 2024 groundbreaking and remains underway; LPSC/Entergy materials support utility planning for Laidley/Evest load, but no parish building permit, certificate of occupancy, energized IT load, or full-campus completion evidence was located in accessible public records.

actions.result_status: LED announced Meta’s planned $10 billion-plus AI-optimized data center in northeast Louisiana/Richland Parish; the announcement did not publish a parish building permit or vote tally.
actions.access_caveat: State announcement is not parish zoning, building, or occupancy approval.
actions.evidence_note: The announcement is retained as state/company evidence, separate from later LPSC utility action.

actions.government_body: Louisiana Department of Transportation and Development
actions.result_status: DOTD announced conversion of three US 80 intersections near the Meta development site to all-way stop control following a traffic-engineering study; this is roadway context, not site-plan or building approval.
actions.access_caveat: DOTD announcement does not disclose the private site permit register or construction/occupancy status.
actions.evidence_note: Traffic action confirms project-related public infrastructure context, not a vote on the data center.

actions.result_status: LPSC Order U-37425 accepted a settlement and approved the generation and transmission resources proposed in connection with service to a single customer project in North Louisiana, subject to conditions; LPSC docket materials identify the customer project as Meta/Laidley in Richland Parish.
actions.vote_tally: not published in the accessible order synopsis
actions.access_caveat: Utility commission approval is not parish zoning, a building permit, a CO, or proof that IT load is energized.
actions.evidence_note: This is the strongest government action located, but it is expressly limited to utility generation/transmission resources.

actions.government_body: Louisiana Economic Development / Louisiana Public Service Commission docket
actions.result_status: LED’s docket letter states Evest LLC, a Meta subsidiary, expressed interest in a significant Richland Parish investment conditional on power availability, including initial utility contract power by 2028; this is not a new parish approval.
actions.case_or_ordinance_permit_number: LPSC docket exhibit; docket number not assigned in the letter
actions.access_caveat: The filing is an economic-development confirmation in a utility docket and uses conditional language; it does not establish a building permit or live service.
actions.evidence_note: Conditional power language is preserved because it conflicts with any assumption of completed energization.

actions.result_status: Entergy announced an additional agreement with Meta for the Northeast Louisiana hyperscale data center, stating the combined agreements are expected to provide about $2.65 billion in customer benefits and that the project has potential to scale up to 5 GW.
actions.access_caveat: Utility/customer agreement announcement is not a local land-use approval, building permit, CO, or proof of energized IT load.
actions.evidence_note: Supports power-planning and scale context; the LPSC application for Evest remained a certification request rather than a completed site-operational milestone.

actions.result_status: LED announced Meta is committing more than $50 billion to the Richland Parish Data Center project, expanding the campus to nearly 10 million square feet and 5 GW of IT capacity; LED also cited 7,500 construction jobs, approximately 1,000 operational jobs, more than $1.6 billion already contracted with local companies, and Source Louisiana as the primary subcontracting portal.
actions.access_caveat: State/company expansion announcement is not a parish building permit, CO, or evidence that IT load is energized.
actions.evidence_note: This is the current official state scale statement and supersedes the original 4 million square foot / $10 billion-plus announcement for planned scale.

actions.result_status: Meta confirmed it is expanding the Richland Parish, Louisiana AI-optimized data center to 5 GW in compute capacity, calling it the largest in Meta's fleet and the home of Hyperion, while stating the site has contracted more than $1.6 billion with Louisiana businesses since breaking ground.
actions.access_caveat: Company update confirms planned scale and ongoing construction/community investment, not local permitting or operational status.
actions.evidence_note: Company source corroborates LED's 5 GW expansion and confirms construction has begun, but does not provide a parish permit number.

owner: Meta Platforms, Inc.; utility docket materials identify Laidley LLC and Evest LLC as Meta-related project/customer entities in Richland Parish.

sources.match_reason: Exact Phase3↔regional stable-ID pair; seed merged only with explicit evidence

contradictions.details: LED's July 13, 2026 expansion announcement states the campus is expanding to nearly 10 million square feet and 5 GW of IT capacity, while the contractor/community project site still describes a 4 million-square-foot campus. Treat 5 GW / nearly 10 million square feet as the current official announced planned scale and 4 million square feet as stale or initial-phase public site language until reconciled by Meta or local permits.

LPSC materials distinguish Project Laidley from Evest LLC's adjacent proposed hyperscale data center, while Meta/LED public communications present the Richland Parish Data Center expansion as one Meta campus/Hyperion buildout. Track as a single Meta Richland Parish/Hyperion campus for this record, with the entity distinction retained in notes.

history.status_as_of_cutoff: Under construction with a major announced expansion. LPSC approved generation/transmission resources for service to the North Louisiana customer project, but that utility order is not a local land-use or building approval and does not establish full-campus completion or energized IT load.
history.note: Pre-refresh values retained before the 2026-08-11 source refresh.
